answer_plain: Adding microbes that carry the carbon-monoxide-eating genes to a sample that had none makes uptake start: roughly 8.75 to 199 millionths of a mole per m² over two weeks, depending on whether presence alone or the amount added matters. Adding a microbe without those genes changes nothing. Where such microbes are already present, adding more raises uptake only slightly (0.55 % at 1 % added, 2.7 % at 5 % added).
answer_science: Inoculation changes the community: the reasoner memberships of the added genome are reused and the community factor γ_CO is recomputed for the hypothetical community. Adding a CO-carrier genome to 51PRr3, whose deduced carrier share is zero, opens CO uptake. The amount depends on the coupling between carrier share and rate: under presence coupling, uptake is 125 µmol m⁻² (90 % interval 22.3 to 501 µmol m⁻²) at any dose, whereas under share-proportional coupling it rises from 8.75 µmol m⁻² at 0.1 % to 199 µmol m⁻² at 5 % inoculum. A non-carrier genome leaves uptake at zero under both couplings. Where carriers are already present (V53PRr2), proportional coupling gives gains of 0.55 % at 1 % and 2.7 % at 5 %.

limits_plain: The range shows how much the answer moves when uncertain numbers in the models are varied; the models themselves could also be wrong. The scenario assumes the added microbes survive and work immediately in dry desert sand without dying off.
limits_science: The inoculum share is a scenario value; survival and establishment of the added organism in desert sand are outside the model. Which coupling holds is untested, and the two couplings bracket the response.

admissibility.scope: Joint parameter and literature-constant uncertainty only; excludes model-structure error.

gates.rule: Closed when sample has 0 MAGs entailed as carrying Group 1h [NiFe]-hydrogenase; fixes J_H2 = 0 exactly.
Closed when sample has 0 MAGs entailed as carrying Form I CO dehydrogenase; fixes J_CO = 0 exactly.
Closed when sample has 0 MAGs carrying both Group 1h [NiFe]-hydrogenase and CBB RuBisCO; fixes C_fixed = 0 exactly.

inputs.name: psi_entry_mpa

inputs.meaning: Thermal Q10 factor per 10 degC above the 25 degC reference temperature
inputs.name: q10
inputs.note: Bounds [1.0, 2.0] from external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES (spanning no thermal amplification Q10=1 to the reference Q10=2).

inputs.meaning: Campbell water-retention pore-size distribution exponent b
inputs.name: retention_b
inputs.note: Bounds [2.0, 6.0] with mode 4.0 reuse the transfer grid in external_transfer.py:CANDIDATES (widening planning.parameter_ensemble [3.0, 5.0]).

source.title: Scenario ensemble (3-5) widened to the cross-desert transfer grid (2-6)

inputs.meaning: Water potential above which microbial moisture activation reaches 1
inputs.name: wet_activation_mpa
inputs.note: Log-uniform on magnitude over [-0.3, -0.03] MPa around the -0.1 MPa reference threshold (half an order of magnitude each side, strictly between dry_threshold_mpa and psi_entry_mpa).
